testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hide an origin plane from its browser menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:143:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hide an origin plane from its browser menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the YZ origin plane is hidden and its browser row is visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row ✔ Then the context menu offers Visibility and New Sketch ✔ And Visibility is not checked ✔ When the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the plane remains visible as a translucent plane beside the block ✔ When the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row again ✔ Then Visibility is checked ✔ When the user chooses Visibility again ✔ Then the plane is hidden and the block remains visible
